meta.title: Casa São Nuno · Guest Guide
meta.description: Digital guest guide of Casa São Nuno in Fátima: check-in and check-out, meals, Wi-Fi, bar, hotel rules and places to visit.

guide.title: Everything for your stay
guide.text: Choose a topic to find the information you need in seconds.
guide.visit: Aljustrel, home of the shepherd children

welcome.title: It is a joy to welcome you
welcome.p1: Thank you for choosing Casa São Nuno for your stay in Fátima. We have prepared this guide so that everything you need is always at hand: times, services and suggestions to discover the region.
welcome.p2: We wish you a peaceful stay, full of good moments. If you need anything at all, our reception team will be delighted to help.

checkin.title: Check-in & Check-out
checkin.groupsText: Guests travelling in a group are kindly asked to check out by 11:00.
checkin.luggageText: No need to worry about your luggage. We have a room next to reception where you can leave your bags before check-in or after check-out.

meals.title: Restaurant & Meals
meals.intro: Enjoy your meals in a calm and welcoming atmosphere. Below you will find the hours and location of each meal.
meals.noticeText: If you enter the dining room during the last 30 minutes of service, some dishes may no longer be replenished.

wifi.title: Wi-Fi
wifi.intro: Connect to our wireless network with the details below.
wifi.copyError: Could not copy. Please enter the password manually.
wifi.help: Open your phone's Wi-Fi settings, select the network “Casa São Nuno” and paste or type the password.

bar.title: The Bar
bar.text: A bright and welcoming space to unwind at the end of the day. Enjoy a coffee, a drink or a quiet conversation in a calm and comfortable setting.

rules.title: Hotel Rules
rules.intro: To ensure a pleasant stay for everyone, we kindly ask for your cooperation.
rules.smokingText: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the hotel premises.
rules.quietText: After 23:00, we kindly ask you to avoid making noise, out of respect for other guests' rest.

eat.title: Places to Eat
eat.intro: Our suggestion for a meal in Fátima.

visit.title: Places to Visit
visit.intro: Fátima and its surroundings hold places of deep historical and spiritual meaning. Here is our suggestion.
visit.aljSubtitle: The land of the three shepherd children
visit.aljP1: Aljustrel is a small village known as the birthplace of the three shepherd children of Fátima: Lúcia dos Santos and her cousins Francisco and Jacinta Marto, who witnessed the apparitions of Our Lady of Fátima in 1917.
visit.aljP2: It is a place of great historical and spiritual importance, where you can visit the former homes of the shepherd children and discover more about the story of the apparitions of Fátima.

install.title: Keep the guide on your phone
install.text: Add the Casa São Nuno Guest Guide to your home screen and open it like an app — even without an internet connection.
install.ios1: Tap the Share button (in the toolbar or in the ••• menu).
install.android1: Open the browser menu (⋮) at the top right.
install.android2: Choose “Install app” or “Add to Home screen”.
install.desktop1: Click the install icon in the address bar, or open the browser menu and choose “Install”.
install.installed: The guide is already installed on this device.
